## About
My name is Peter Wilson, founder and manager of Linkable Contracting. I got my start as a lead installer in commercial construction, then worked as an independent contractor and remodeling specialist for a large home service retailer, traveling throughout metro Atlanta. When that company phased out its remodeling division, I took a leap of faith and branched out on my own.
We're a licensed and insured contractor based in Smyrna. We know that letting someone into your home is a personal decision, so we treat every project as if it were our own home and stay transparent the whole way through.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 39 Google reviews. As one homeowner put it, we made her bathroom remodel "an efficient and stressless project."

## Services
- Kitchen Projects: Kitchen remodels planned around how your family uses the space, with a price and timeline agreed up front.
- Bathroom Projects: From en-suite baths to full master bathroom renovations.
- Basements and Flex Spaces: Turning a basement or extra room into space your family will actually use.

## FAQ
Q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
A: It depends on the complexity of the renovation. On average, a complete bathroom remodel takes approximately 2-3 weeks, without delays.

Q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
A: A kitchen remodel takes approximately 3-4 weeks on average, without delays.

Q: Do you provide a dumpster for the debris?
A: Yes. We schedule dumpster delivery and pickup for the project, and the cost of the dumpster is included in the contract price.

Q: Do you get special contractor pricing from vendors?
A: Yes, we work with specific vendors. When we get contractor pricing, the discount is passed on to you.

Q: Who buys the materials for the project?
A: We purchase all raw materials. You select and purchase other materials, like tile and fixtures.
